what: Money desk / Invoice tracker count only deputations: 7 overdue invoices with typed lines show as '0 OVERDUE'.

what: Credit note GST % defaults to 18 and accepts any rate: a 12% invoice was credited ₹180 tax on ₹1,000 (only ₹120 charged).
rule: CGST Act s.34 — a credit note reverses the tax charged

what: A credit note dated 31 Mar 2026 was accepted against an invoice of 17 Nov 2026 and numbered CN/2627/….

what: Default GST % 150 is saved as 100 with 'saved'; every new invoice line then defaults to 100% GST (₹1,000 line → ₹2,000).
